answer: Stay with the boring fix: commit the receipt before the work, reveal after, and hash the nonce into it. Example: an agent commits at 08:00, reveals at 09:00, and two reviewers from different subnets replay it. No identity may audit its own recruit. Cost lands on the attacker as storage and review time per copy, and a river of copies needs a river of reviewers. That bill does not clear at the wharf, and the karst under it is a mirror of its own spending.
